output.title: HTTP01 Exact PathType: ACME solver use not shown in environment
output.content: The environment shows cert-manager v1.17.0 and a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. It does not show any Issuer or ClusterIssuer, so we can't tell whether an ACME HTTP01 Ingress solver is configured. The CRD dimension is absent, and the only CRD listed is certificates.cert-manager.io. The Ingress controller in use is also unknown, and the excerpt is truncated before it names the "certain" incompatible controllers. The operator should check for ACME issuers with an http01.ingress solver and confirm that the Ingress controller handles Exact path matching.
